summary: Submission shows Completed while the fixture service failed and nothing persisted.

environment.boundary: Feedback review only; no real or paid service.

journeys.limit: UI says Completed; backend failed in fixture.

evidence.caption: Completed remains after simulated 503 with no record.

findings.title: Success message remains after service failure
findings.expected: Failure or pending state when nothing is stored.
findings.observed: Completed remains; fixture reports 503 and no record.
findings.expectation_basis: Feedback should match verified outcome for the submission task.
findings.consequence: User believes the request was received when it was not.
findings.severity_reason: False success on a consequential submission.
findings.confidence_reason: Stipulated UI and fixture service outcome.

recommendation.change: Replace or qualify Completed when persistence fails; offer retry with stable id when available.
recommendation.tradeoff: Stricter gating may delay perceived completion.
recommendation.disconfirming_result: If failure removes Completed and shows retry, the mismatch would not reproduce.

findings.acceptance_test: Given simulated 503, Submit must not leave Completed without error or retry guidance.

limitations: No live service or duplicate-submit test executed.
Retry behavior described in packet, not walked.
plan: Align completion UI with verified persistence (harms_trust, widespread) before polish.
human_follow_up: Submit and check whether the request exists outside the success message.
